newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Kohler says unspecified talks terminated.
newsitem.headline: Kohler says unspecified talks terminated.

text.p: South African packaging firm Kohler Ltd said on Monday that unspecified talks, which may have had an effect on its share price, had been terminated.
No reasons were given for the termination of discussions other than to say that an earlier cautionary had thus been withdrawn.
In a separate announcement Kohler parent Malbak Ltd said that talks with fellow packaging firm Lenco Holdings had also ended. No further details were given.
The announcements follow a flood of rumours in the market that industrial conglomerate Rembrandt Group Ltd (Remgro) was set to buy Malbak through its Lenco unit.
Malbak, Kohler and Lenco had all issued cautionary announcements, saying they were in unspecified talks.
